lede: D'auto Access at 9 Kaki Bukit Rd 3, East Point Terrace is a car workshop for servicing and repairs, with a focus on Mercedes-Benz and BMW.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention clear costs explained up front, photos and videos sent on WhatsApp, an oil leak found and fixed with a valve cover and water pump replacement, and turbo pipe advice on a BMW.
faqs: Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
sources: its Google Maps listing and its website
services_note: Services listed on its website. Ask the workshop for its full list.
makes_note: Its website says it caters mostly to Mercedes-Benz and BMW owners; BMW is also named by customers on Google Maps.
good_to_know: Carries genuine Mercedes-Benz parts and OEM parts, according to its website
Can also help with selling a car and vehicle financing and insurance, according to its website
